videos.title: Shinsegae’s Chung Yong-jin to Issue Public Apology Tomorrow... Was He Informed? Was There Intent?...

3. Starbucks marketing staff have claimed that their actions were not intentional, but the results of a forensic examination of their smartphones will be released, and there is concern among citizens' groups that the company's unethical behavior may not be effectively regulated by the government due to its significant ownership by the National Pension Service.

videos.title: 제주반도체 주가 전망 와 연휴에 반도체 관련 이런 대형 호재 속보가 나오네요 ? 화요일 부터 반드시 이렇게 대응 하세요

videos.title: [한미반도체 주가전망] 한미반도체 주가 전망! 반도체 후공정 독점 수주 시나리오와 310,000원 매물대 세력 원가 전격 대공개!

videos.title: [SFA반도체 주가전망] 끝나지 않은 상승..!! 지금부터 반드시 집중!!! 주주라면 필히 시청하셔서 도움 받아가시기 바랍니다.

videos.title: [한미반도체 주가 전망] 신고가 후 25% 폭락.. 무조건 "여기"부터 반전 시작입니다! 3분만 집중 #한미반도체
videos.subtitle_summary:

2. 글로벌 투자 은행이 한미반도체 목표 주가를 50만 원으로 상향 주정했다는 보고서가 나왔습니다. 이번 목표가는 2028년 예상 주당 순위익 기준 47배의 주가 수익 비율을 적용해서 산출한 것으로, 2024년과 2025년 평균 대비 약 30% 할인된 보수적인 수치입니다.
3. 한미반도체 분야의 수요가 고대 역물리 HBM에서 2.5D 로직, HBF와 같은 새로운 영역으로 넓어지고 있으며, 고객사도 다양화되고 있습니다.

videos.title: Jang Dong-hyeok: “(The ruling party’s) Starbucks boycott will only last until June 3rd... The tar...
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Jang Dong-hyeok predicts that the Starbucks boycott by the ruling party will last until June 3rd, suggesting they will return to Starbucks coffee after that date. He recalls the opposition party's strong stance against Samsung in 2016, which quickly faded away after the election.
2. Park Geun-hye's impeachment trial and special investigation have stirred public anger, which is being directed towards Starbucks as a campaign issue for the upcoming elections. The opposition party has previously advocated for the closure of Hakuishima nuclear power plants and discussed importing Japanese products with President Moon Jae-in.
3. Jang Dong-hyeok urges voters to show their support for freedom by choosing their own coffee on this Friday, suggesting that this election is a battle between Park Geun-hye and her supporters (the "freedom party") and Moon Jae-in and his supporters ("the opposition party").
